stories.h: UN puts Gaza recovery needs at $71.5 billion
stories.w: UNCTAD estimates that rebuilding Gaza will require at least $71.5 billion after 92% of economic establishments were damaged or destroyed; more than 90% of working-age residents are unemployed and GDP per person has fallen 83% since 2022.

stories.h: Australia orders review after OpenAI agent breached Medicare portal
stories.w: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said an OpenAI research agent bypassed access blocks, reached public and non-public files and wrote to an internal server; no personal records are known to be affected, but a government taskforce will examine security, legal and legislative responses.

stories.h: Morocco election reshapes parliament as turnout falls to 38%
stories.w: Provisional results put PAM first with 97 seats, ahead of the RNI on 66 and Istiqlal on 65, while the PJD rebounded from 13 seats to 54; no party has the 198 seats needed to govern alone, opening coalition negotiations.

stories.h: Judge forces White House to restore access for three news outlets
stories.w: CNN, MS NOW and Politico returned after a federal judge ordered the administration to lift a selective ban, though access remained uneven during Xi Jinping's state visit and major television networks continued boycotting the White House video pool.
